record.question: Haemodialysis is a medical procedure used to treat patients with kidney failure by:
options: Filtering the blood artificially to remove waste products.
record.explanation: Answer A: Filtering the blood artificially to remove waste products.. Hemodialysis passes blood through a dialyzer to remove wastes and excess fluid when kidney function is inadequate. Reference: https://www.niddk.nih.gov/health-information/kidney-disease/kidney-failure/hemodialysis; https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/000821.htm. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
